authentication_checks.detail: REPORT INTEGRATION ALLOWED WITH REQUIRED LIMITATIONS

determinism: fixed ordering, seeds, plot style, PNG metadata, CSV float format, and LF newlines

figure_records.interpretation: LLM-assisted methods lead four cases; mRMR and IV then Boruta lead one each.
figure_records.limitation: Aggregate winners were supplied and were not independently recomputed from row-level predictions.
figure_records.population: Six feature-selection cases: three datasets × two models; full_features excluded
figure_records.title: Updated winner in each dataset × model case

figure_records.interpretation: The latest correction moves Home Credit LR to mRMR at 0.77 and LendingClub LR to LLM at 0.74.
figure_records.limitation: This is a source-revision sequence, not calendar-time model performance; only three revision anchors exist.
figure_records.population: Six dataset × model cases across three discrete evidence revisions
figure_records.title: AUC evidence-revision timeline

figure_records.interpretation: The matrix exposes cross-metric consistency and exceptions without comparing unlike metric magnitudes.
figure_records.limitation: This workbook-only aggregate view does not supersede the later LR AUC/Gini corrections shown in Figures 1 and 2.
figure_records.metric_definition: Winner method and model, with method-family background
figure_records.title: Workbook-only winner matrix for all supplied metrics

figure_records.interpretation: The LLM comparison wins all three KS rows by the stated direction rule.
figure_records.limitation: Aggregate winners only; no row-level KS curves or uncertainty were supplied.
figure_records.title: Updated KS winner by dataset

figure_records.interpretation: Winner identities differ by metric, which prevents one-method approval from being inferred from AUC alone.
figure_records.limitation: Threshold definitions and row-level confusion matrices were not supplied with the update.
figure_records.metric_definition: Threshold-dependent classification metrics; higher is better
figure_records.population: Twelve dataset × metric winners across precision, recall, F1, and accuracy
figure_records.title: Threshold-dependent winner metrics

figure_records.interpretation: The supplied LLM comparison wins both error metrics in all three datasets.
figure_records.limitation: These are aggregate error metrics, not calibration curves; updated probability-level predictions were not supplied.
figure_records.metric_definition: Log loss and Brier score; lower is better
figure_records.population: Six dataset × metric winners across log loss and Brier
figure_records.title: Aggregate calibration-error winner metrics

figure_records.interpretation: Home Credit uses LLM then Boruta, Stability 2024 uses LLM then mRMR, and LendingClub retains Random K because 0.0005986 is lower than the supplied LLM value 0.0345.
figure_records.limitation: Aggregate winners only; PSI was not independently recomputed here.
figure_records.title: Updated score-PSI winner by dataset

figure_records.interpretation: The chart preserves ties and retains non-LLM winners whenever the supplied LLM comparison is worse.
figure_records.limitation: Feature-level PSI values and bin-level diagnostics were not supplied.
figure_records.metric_definition: Mean, median, and maximum feature PSI; lower is better
figure_records.population: Nine finalized aggregate dataset × feature-PSI-statistic winners
figure_records.title: Updated selected-feature PSI winners

figure_records.interpretation: LLM-assisted and classical methods each dominate different parts of the metric scorecard; mixed/tied cells remain explicit.
figure_records.limitation: Counts treat each metric equally, do not weight metrics by business importance, and do not supersede the later LR AUC/Gini corrections.
figure_records.metric_definition: Count of aggregate metric wins by method family
figure_records.population: Fifteen workbook-supplied metric winners per dataset
figure_records.title: Workbook-only cross-metric winner-family mix

figure_records.interpretation: Plain LLM leads Home Credit; LLM then mRMR leads Stability 2024 and LendingClub v2.
figure_records.limitation: Aggregate point estimates; no new inferential comparison is claimed.
figure_records.title: Workbook-supplied CatBoost AUC and Gini winners

figure_records.interpretation: LLM and LLM then mRMR each win two cases; mRMR and IV then Boruta each win one.
figure_records.limitation: Counts summarize leaders and do not imply statistical superiority.
figure_records.title: Updated cross-case feature-selection winner count

figure_records.interpretation: The same winner leads lift and capture within each dataset, as expected from the shared top-decile ranking cutoff.
figure_records.limitation: Aggregate winners only; no gain/lift curves or decile-level rows were supplied.
figure_records.metric_definition: Lift and bad-rate capture at the highest-risk decile; higher is better
figure_records.population: Six dataset × metric winners across lift and bad-rate capture at 10%
figure_records.title: Top-decile business metric winners

figure_records.interpretation: Every panel contains one winner and the displayed AUC exactly matches the finalized six-case table.
figure_records.limitation: Profiles are deterministic AUC-matched references, not empirical ROC estimates; row-level finalized predictions were not supplied.
figure_records.metric_definition: False-positive rate versus true-positive rate; each monotone reference profile has trapezoidal area equal to the finalized table AUC
figure_records.population: Exactly six finalized feature-selection winners: three datasets × two models
figure_records.title: Finalized winner-only ROC reference profiles

figure_records.interpretation: Each panel contains only the finalized AUC winner and states whether a matching calibration curve is mathematically feasible and identifiable.
figure_records.limitation: Aggregate AUC/Brier/log-loss values do not determine calibration-bin coordinates; inconsistent pairs are not plotted as if valid.
figure_records.metric_definition: Calibration feasibility under log loss ≥ 2 × Brier; reliability coordinates require row-level probabilities
figure_records.population: Exactly six finalized AUC winners, with matching-method Brier/log-loss values drawn from the resolved 45-metric scorecard where available
figure_records.title: Finalized winner-only calibration feasibility
